edit.description: isPendingRelocated (~:4029) delegates to computeStateRootRel (~:683) instead of re-deriving the escape check

summary: isPendingRelocated re-derives computeStateRootRel's escape check byte-for-byte instead of calling it

per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

tests: isPendingRelocated and computeStateRootRel agree on a relocated (out-of-tree) pendingPath and on a normal in-tree one
acceptance: isPendingRelocated's body is computeStateRootRel(this.opts.repoRoot, this.pendingPath) === undefined; no independent relative()/escape-check duplication remains
notes: computeStateRootRel's own docstring (Dispatcher.ts:673-682) claims it's shared by every consumer and neither re-derives it — isPendingRelocated is a third, undocumented re-derivation the docstring doesn't know about. Found by posture sweep, not audit.
